## Reflection

The correct destabilizer call was driven by quantitative morphology plus atlas, not visual impression. Extreme nuc_solidity and nuc_form_factor loss with increased frac_large_nucleus persisted even at the lowest 0.003 uM dose, and compare_to_reference_atlas returned 7/10 microtubule destabilizers, which anchored the hypothesis. The frac_mitotic_like dose_response was negative and non-significant and did not cleanly show an early arrest peak, so I carried Aurora at 0.10-0.12 too long and spent late queries on act_std and act_tub_ratio trajectories without new wells.
